description: Server-side GA4 purchases, refunds and sign-ups
name: Google Analytics 4

images.title: Connected in a few minutes
images.description: Add the Measurement ID and an API secret from your GA4 web stream, validate, then turn on Enable Integration.

images.title: You choose what GA4 gets
images.description: Pick when purchases are sent, and turn refunds, canceled orders and sign-ups on or off in the app settings.

images.title: Every purchase, counted in GA4
images.description: Paid orders are sent to GA4 from the server with items, tax, shipping and coupon, and can join the shopper's web session.

images.title: Refunds that match your revenue
images.description: Full and partial refunds are sent as GA4 refund events, and canceled orders can be reported as refunded.
